headline: Executive order sets new pay rates for certain federal workers, based on its title, likely for the year 2007.
what_it_does: This order adjusts pay rates for certain federal government jobs. No summary was provided, so the exact groups and amounts are not confirmed here. Orders with this title are usually issued each year and put annual federal pay raises into effect.

who_it_affects.how: Their pay rates may be changed under the new pay schedules this order sets.
